name: pdf-viewer
description: Renders embedded PDFs with a custom, touch-friendly viewer (fit-to-width pages, prev/next, swipe) instead of the browser's native PDF plugin, which mobile Safari/Chrome barely support inside an iframe

quartz.name: pdf-viewer
quartz.description: Custom PDF.js-based viewer for ![[file.pdf]] embeds: fit-to-width rendering sized to the PDF's real page shape, prev/next controls, swipe-to-turn on touch, and a download fallback
